description: React component for managing cost tracking settings, including provider discounts, fetching and updating configuration via API, and UI interactions with modals and tabs.

methods.name: fetchDiscountConfig
methods.description: Fetches the discount configuration from the backend API.

methods.name: saveDiscountConfig
methods.description: Saves the updated discount configuration to the backend API.

methods.name: handleAddProvider
methods.description: Handles adding a new provider discount, including validation and updating state.

methods.name: handleModalCancel
methods.description: Resets modal form and state when canceling the add provider modal.

methods.name: handleFormSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission for adding a provider discount.

methods.name: handleRemoveProvider
methods.description: Removes a provider discount after user confirmation.

methods.name: handleDiscountChange
methods.description: Updates discount value for a provider and saves to backend.
